description: This file defines a utility class 'AzureTableDataManager<T>' for managing CRUD operations on Azure Table Storage within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for table initialization, deletion, clearing, and entity operations such as create, read, update, delete, and bulk operations, with detailed logging and retry mechanisms.

classes.name: AzureTableDataManager<T>
classes.description: A generic internal class for managing Azure Table storage entities, providing methods for table creation, deletion, CRUD operations, bulk operations, and internal utilities, with extensive logging and retry handling.

methods.name: InitTableAsync
methods.description: Initializes connection to the Azure table, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: DeleteTableAsync
methods.description: Deletes the Azure table.

methods.name: ClearTableAsync
methods.description: Clears all entries from the Azure table by reading all entries and deleting them in batches.

methods.name: CreateTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Inserts a new entity into the table, failing if it already exists.

methods.name: UpsertTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Creates or updates (overwrites) a given entity in the table.

methods.name: InsertTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Inserts a new entity and returns success status and ETag.

methods.name: MergeTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Merges partial updates into an existing entity.

methods.name: UpdateTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing entity with concurrency control via ETag.

methods.name: DeleteTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Deletes an entity using its partition key, row key, and ETag.

methods.name: ReadSingleTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Reads a single entity based on partition and row keys, returning the entity and its ETag.

methods.name: ReadAllTableEntriesForPartitionAsync
methods.description: Reads all entities within a specific partition.

methods.name: ReadAllTableEntriesAsync
methods.description: Reads all entities in the table.

methods.name: DeleteTableEntriesAsync
methods.description: Deletes multiple entities in a batch.

methods.name: ReadTableEntriesAndEtagsAsync
methods.description: Reads entities with their ETags, optionally filtered.

methods.name: BulkInsertTableEntries
methods.description: Inserts multiple entities in a batch.

methods.name: InsertTwoTableEntriesConditionallyAsync
methods.description: Conditionally inserts or updates two entities atomically.

methods.name: UpdateTwoTableEntriesConditionallyAsync
methods.description: Conditionally updates two entities atomically.

methods.name: GetCloudTableCreationClientAsync
methods.description: Gets a TableServiceClient asynchronously, with error logging.

methods.name: CheckAlertWriteError
methods.description: Logs warnings or errors based on the exception and error type.

methods.name: CheckAlertSlowAccess
methods.description: Logs a warning if an operation exceeds its configured timeout.
